limits: ABBA is one four-arm experiment, not a confidence interval or broad workload suite.
200K is capacity/parity against an archived reference, not a fresh performance comparison.
Exact IDs apply to these deterministic fixtures and this frozen stack, not a general model-quality proof.
Native PP/TG exclude model load; request wall times are separate fields.
Micro chunk+merge latency reduction is distinct from model PP/TG throughput gain.
Public source port has not been compiled or qualified separately and has not been pushed.
Cancel receipt records successful equality of PID/starttime via the reviewed helper; the raw PID and starttime values were not retained and cannot be independently reconstructed from this receipt.
